messages.subject: Follow-up | Social licence and corporate-affairs execution across Rio Tinto growth projects
messages.body:
Dear Company Secretarial Team,

Please route this follow-up to Ms. Trudi Charles, Chief Legal, Governance & Corporate Affairs Officer.

I wanted to follow up on the executive introduction routed to Rio Tinto last week, but with a narrower proposition around the Corporate Affairs portfolio you now lead. Rio Tinto's current growth program is being executed across jurisdictions where social licence and partnerships are explicitly part of the business model, from Simandou and Oyu Tolgoi to the Pilbara and the expanding lithium portfolio.

The opportunity I see is not generic stakeholder engagement. It is tighter operating governance around external commitments: ensuring government, community, Indigenous, regulatory and sustainability obligations have clear owners, evidence, escalation paths and executive visibility as projects move from development into operation. That discipline becomes more important as Rio Tinto simplifies its operating model while accelerating major projects.

At AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department. My work integrates government and regulatory relations, social performance, corporate affairs, ESG, executive advisory and cross-functional follow-through across a large mining operation. I coordinate high-scrutiny issues across environment, HSE, legal, HR, procurement, finance, security and technical teams and support stakeholder governance around renewable-energy and carbon-accounting initiatives.

If this operating-side profile is relevant to the Corporate Affairs agenda you are shaping, I would value a confidential conversation about director-level, regional or country-facing mandates where disciplined external-affairs execution can support Rio Tinto's growth and partnership objectives. I have refined my CV specifically around that contribution.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
